adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx onError, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` is always a non-empty string due to template-string coercion (even when `err.data?.code` is undefined), so `message || t("unable_to_add_guests")` will never use the fallback. This can result in user-facing toasts like `undefined: <...>` and `t(err.message)` may display raw/untranslated keys if `err.message` isn’t a valid locale key.
